inputs.text: Five months after the ceasefire was announced, families in Gaza are still facing airstrikes, gunfire, shelling and danger at sea. That is not a return to normal life; a declaration means little if people cannot protect their homes, earn a living or keep their children safe. The priority should be restoring security, delivering practical help and allowing families to rebuild—not political claims that the crisis is over. A ceasefire must be upheld in practice, or it is only words.
